title: MachinePool
description: Represents a machine pool within a cluster, defining a group of compute nodes with shared configuration.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine pool.

instance_type.description: The cloud provider instance type for nodes in this pool.

replicas.description: The fixed number of nodes in this machine pool.

autoscaling.description: Autoscaling configuration for the machine pool.

min_replicas.description: The minimum number of nodes when autoscaling is enabled.

max_replicas.description: The maximum number of nodes when autoscaling is enabled.

availability_zones.description: The availability zones where nodes will be placed.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels applied to nodes in this pool.

taints.description: Kubernetes taints applied to nodes in this pool.
